sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR ERN NC AND SERN VA
sections.text: AMENDED FOR ADDITION OF 5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY OVER NERN CO.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ESELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL PERSIST INTO THIS EVENING AND AID IN MAINTAINING MID TO UPPER 50S DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. BOUNDARY LAYER IS SLOWLY DESTABILIZING AS TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE 70S...AND WILL SUPPORT MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG BY PEAK HEATING. WV IMAGERY SHOWS SEVERAL UPPER IMPULSES APPROACHING THE REGION...ONE OF WHICH IS ASSOCIATED WITH A 90 KT UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAK MOVING E ACROSS WRN/CNTRL MT. THESE FEATURES ARE ASSISTING IN ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE VERY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS POSING A THREAT FOR SIG HAIL. PRIMARY CHANGE WITH THIS OUTLOOK UPDATE WAS TO FOCUS THE 5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS DUE TO THE EXPECTED SUPERCELL MODE AND INCREASING LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH CURVATURE LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. REF WW 463 AND ASSOCIATED MCD/S FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS WIDESPREAD LOW-LEVEL CLOUD COVER OVER FAR ERN CO INTO WRN KS...WHILE CLEAR SKIES OVER THE FRONT RANGE ARE AIDING IN STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION AND SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. MOST LIKELY SCENARIO FOR THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS IS FOR STORMS TO EVOLVE OFF THE FRONT RANGE AS CLOUDS OVER THE PLAINS CONTINUE TO ERODE AND AIRMASS DESTABILIZES. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ALONG DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE LEFT OVER BY DISSIPATING CLOUD SHIELD. SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT A HYBRID SUPERCELL/MULTICELL MODE POSING A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT...AND POSSIBLY AN ISOLATED TORNADO. BY EVENING...NUMEROUS STORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER ERN CO...WITH MERGERS AIDING IN UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS THAT WILL MOVE E INTO WRN KS AND POSE A CONTINUED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS. REFER TO MCD/S 1611 AND 1613 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION INTO THE ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON. MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1500-2500 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR RANGING FROM 30-40 KT WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THROUGH EVENING. NO MAJOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK.

sections.title: NERN NM ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE INTO NWRN OK
sections.text: SURFACE COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM S-CNTRL KS INTO THE TX PANHANDLE...AND THEN WNWWD ACROSS NERN NM. TEMPERATURES ARE RISING INTO THE 90S ALONG AND S OF THE BOUNDARY...WHICH IS AIDING IN STRONG DESTABILIZATION. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE FRONT OVER NERN NM AND EVENTUALLY THE TX PANHANDLE DURING THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON...AND THEN SPREAD E INTO NWRN OK THIS EVENING. THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE CAPE AND A DEEP WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER MAY YIELD A DAMAGING WIND THREAT. REF MCD 1611 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS. ..GARNER.. 08/03/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SAT AUG 03 2013/

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE OVERALL UPPER FLOW PATTERN IS FORECAST TO REMAIN LARGELY UNCHANGED THIS PERIOD...WITH A POSITIVELY TILTED TROUGH EXTENDING FROM THE CANADIAN ROCKIES SWWD ACROSS THE PAC NW INTO THE ERN PACIFIC...A RIDGE CENTERED OVER THE SRN PLAINS...AND A LARGE TROUGH OVER ERN NOAM. AT THE SURFACE...A WEAK COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM NEW ENGLAND WSWWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY AREA -- WEST OF WHICH CONVECTIVE CONTAMINATION IS YIELDING A MORE ILL-DEFINED SURFACE PATTERN. THE WRN FRINGE OF THIS BOUNDARY -- EXTENDING NWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS -- WILL SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR THE MAIN ZONE OF SEVERE POTENTIAL THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: NRN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ELY COMPONENT TO THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW PREVAILS ACROSS THE NRN AND CENTRAL PLAINS ATTM...ON THE WRN FRINGE OF HIGH PRESSURE BUILDING SWD OUT OF CANADA. THIS GENERAL MOIST UPSLOPE-TYPE FLOW REGIME COMBINED WITH DIURNAL HEATING WILL RESULT IN CONTINUED AIRMASS DESTABILIZATION...AND ISOLATED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT BY MID AFTERNOON. MOST CONCENTRATED AREAS OF CONVECTION REMAIN DIFFICULT TO DISCERN DUE TO SUBTLE SHORT-WAVE FORCING...BUT ATTM CONCENTRATIONS OF STORMS ACROSS ERN CO AND ADJACENT WRN KS AS WELL AS ERN MT AND ADJACENT NERN WY APPEAR LIKELY BY LATE AFTERNOON. WHILE MID-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS MOST OF THE REGION WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT MODEST...VEERING PROFILES WITH HEIGHT SHOULD PROVIDE AMPLE SHEAR FOR SOME UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION...AND ASSOCIATED POTENTIAL FOR HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. DURING THE EVENING...SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD BECOME MAXIMIZED ACROSS ERN MT AND INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS...AS AN INCREASING SLY LOW-LEVEL JET BENEATH THE STRONGER BELT OF MID-LEVEL WLYS SUPPORTS ROTATING STORMS AND ASSOCIATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL ALONG WITH POSSIBLY A TORNADO.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION INTO THE ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS ALREADY UNDERWAY ACROSS THIS REGION -- PARTICULARLY ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS WHERE A VERY MOIST/DESTABILIZING AIRMASS IS INDICATED. SUBTLE SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING IS MOVING EWD ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS ATTM...WHICH COMBINED WITH THE DESTABILIZING AIRMASS AND MODERATE MID-LEVEL FLOW SUPPORTS AN UPGRADE TO SLIGHT RISK FOR EARLY AFTERNOON SEVERE POTENTIAL. REF SWOMCD 1610 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS. MORE LIMITED THREAT MAY EVOLVE LATER THIS AFTERNOON FARTHER N INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION...THE ENTRANCE REGION OF AN UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAK NOSES SEWD INTO THE AREA. WEAKER INSTABILITY HOWEVER SUGGESTS MORE ISOLATED THREAT -- CONSISTENT WITH CONTINUATION SEE TEXT/5% PROBABILITY.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS NRN PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... DOMINANT LARGE-SCALE UPPER-AIR FEATURES REMAIN LARGE CYCLONIC GYRE OVER NRN QUE/HUDSON BAY REGION...AND STG ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER W TX...WITH RIDGING NNWWD ACROSS BLACK HILLS REGION. COMPACT MID-UPPER CYCLONE WAS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY NEAR ERN PORTIONS MT/AB BORDER...AND FCST TO PIVOT EWD OVER SRN SK THROUGH 12Z. AT SFC...23Z MAP SHOWED WAVY COLD FRONT FROM MAINE SWWD ACROSS SERN NY...NRN VA AND SRN KY. FRONT BECAME QUASISTATIONARY WITH LOCALIZED CONVECTIVE ENHANCEMENT AND MESOBETA SCALE REPOSITIONING...FROM OZARKS WWD ACROSS NRN TX PANHANDLE AND NERN NM...THEN NWWD THROUGH CO ROCKIES...CENTRAL WY...AND NWRN MT. FRONT SHOULD MOVE OFFSHORE NEW ENGLAND AND MID-ATLC REGIONS THROUGH PERIOD...TRAILING SWWD OVER SRN NC...NRN GA AND NRN MS BY 12Z.

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: REF WWS 464-465 AND ACCOMPANYING MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE FROM SERN WY TO NERN NM AND NRN TX PANHANDLE. ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LARGELY MULTICELLULAR AND CLUSTERED FROM SERN CO SEWD ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OUTLOOK AREA...GIVEN RELATIVELY WEAK DEEP SHEAR BUT RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IN PRECONVECTIVE ENVIRONMENT. FARTHER N ACROSS ERN CO...WHERE DEEP SHEAR AND BACKED NEAR-SFC FLOW WILL REMAIN MORE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS...CONVECTIVE MODE WILL BECOME MESSIER AND PERHAPS MORE ELEVATED AMIDST STABILIZING EFFECTS OF 1. SPREADING COVERAGE OF RELATIVELY STABLE OUTFLOW AIR AND 2. DIABATIC SFC COOLING. AS SUCH...TORNADO POTENTIAL STILL EXISTS BUT HAS DECREASED BELOW EARLIER CONDITIONS...AND EMPHASIS OF REMAINING RISK IS SHIFTED OFF WIND IN STABILIZED AREAS. ONE OR TWO LARGER CLUSTERS/COMPLEXES OF TSTMS MAY PERSIST INTO LATE EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS INTO PORTIONS SWRN KS...OK PANHANDLE...NRN TX PANHANDLE AND PERHAPS NWRN OK...WITH OCNL DAMAGING GUSTS AND HAIL PSBL.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: REF WWS 463 AND 466...AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS...FOR NEAR-TERM INSIGHTS ON SVR THREAT OVER MT...NERN WY AND WRN DAKOTAS. LLJ AND RELATED REGIME OF WAA AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT ARE FCST TO STRENGTHEN THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS NWRN NEB INTO WRN DAKOTAS. THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASE IN BOTH STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW AND LOW-LEVEL THETAE AVAILABLE TO CONVECTION MOVING ESEWD/SEWD OUT OF MT. UPSCALE GROWTH AND INCREASING COLD-POOL ORGANIZATION ALSO MAY ENHANCE LIFT THROUGH FORWARD-PROPAGATION AND FORCED ASCENT...HELPING RESULTANT MCS TO BE MAINTAINED WELL INTO WRN AND PERHAPS CENTRAL DAKOTAS BEFORE WEAKENING SUBSTANTIALLY. MAIN CONCERN WILL EVOLVE FROM HAIL/WIND MIX NOW APPARENT...TO WIND-DOMINANT SVR THREAT WITH TIME AND EWD EXTENT. ..EDWARDS.. 08/04/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY MOVE SWD ACROSS WCNTRL NEB OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS PARTS OF THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STORMS IN NW NEB IS CURRENTLY ON THE ERN EDGE OF A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F. MESOANALYSIS IS ESTIMATING MLCAPE IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE WHICH SHOULD HELP SUSTAIN THE CONVECTION FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. IN ADDITION TO THE INSTABILITY...LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS ENHANCED ACROSS WRN NEB AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ABOUT 50 KT. THIS SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE SUPPORTIVE OF STORM ROTATION WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGER CORES. AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE MORE INTENSE CELLS. HOWEVER...THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED MAINLY DUE TO WEAKER INSTABILITY IN CNTRL NEB AND LIMITED LARGE-SCALE ASCENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH SEVERE THREAT HAVING RAPIDLY DIMINISHED...AN ADDITIONAL WW WILL BE UNNECESSARY AFTER 16Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY CORES WEAKENED SUBSTANTIALLY IN THE PAST HALF HOUR WITH EARLIER SEVERE CONVECTION ALONG WITH IR CLOUD TOP WARMING AND DIMINISHING CG LIGHTNING TRENDS. THIS SCENARIO WAS WELL-MODELED BY RECENT HRRR RUNS. ALTHOUGH WEAK ISENTROPIC LIFT COULD FOSTER PERSISTENCE OF ELEVATED CONVECTION ALONG THE WRN FLANK OF THIS CLUSTER INTO EARLY AFTERNOON...OVERALL SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN LIMITED. ..GRAMS.. 08/03/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORMS SHOULD FORM DURING EARLY AFTERNOON WITH ISOLATED RISKS FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. PORTIONS OF THE REGION /CENTERED OVER ERN NC/ WILL BE UPGRADED TO SLIGHT RISK IN THE 1630Z D1 OUTLOOK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATE TCU/SMALL CB/S CONTINUING TO INCREASE AHEAD OF A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH REACHING THE PIEDMONT PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. MODIFIED 12Z GSO/MHX/CHS RAOBS SUGGEST BUOYANCY IS AT LEAST MODERATE WITH MLCAPE HAVING REACHED 1500-2000 J/KG...DESPITE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 6-6.5 DEG C/KM. POCKETS OF STRONGER INSOLATION SHOULD FOSTER CONTINUE DESTABILIZATION WHILE LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND SEA BREEZE AID IN SCATTERED TSTMS RELATIVELY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON GIVEN MINIMAL INHIBITION. EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 20-30 KT MAY HELP YIELD A COUPLE OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS PRODUCING LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP/INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHEAST COLORADO SOUTH/SOUTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHEAST NEW MEXICO AND THE NORTHERN TEXAS PANHANDLE. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18 UTC SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATED A WEAK SURFACE LOW IN NORTHWEST OKLAHOMA /NEAR HARPER COUNTY/. TO THE WEST/NORTHWEST OF THIS SURFACE LOW...THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP/INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS SOUTHEAST COLORADO AND NORTHEAST NEW MEXICO IN A MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME. THESE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE EASTWARD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING HOURS. MODEST WEST/SOUTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL FLOW /15-25 KTS/ COUPLED WITH EASTERLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW OF 10-15 KTS WILL YIELD A DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILE SUPPORTIVE OF MULTI-CELL CLUSTERS AND TRANSIENT SUPERCELL-LIKE STRUCTURES. AT THIS TIME THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH ANY OF THE STRONGER STORMS. IF THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY IS MORE THAN CURRENTLY EXPECTED...A WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL COMMENCE THIS AFTERNOON AS CONVECTION ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER N-CNTRL MT LIKELY INTENSIFIES INTO A FEW SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY RISK...BUT SEVERE WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE COVERAGE HAS BEEN ON THE INCREASE OVER THE PAST HALF HOUR AIDED BY A BELT OF ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING E/NEWD OVER N-CNTRL MT. ALTHOUGH SURFACE TEMPERATURES ARE STILL ONLY IN THE UPPER 60S TO MIDDLE 70S...CONTINUED HEATING WILL FOSTER GREATER DESTABILIZATION DOWNSTREAM OF THIS INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS SUCH AS THE WRF-NSSL/NMM AND HRRR ARE RATHER CONSISTENT IN INTENSIFYING THIS CONVECTION AS IT DEVELOPS EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THIS SCENARIO APPEARS PLAUSIBLE AND GIVEN THE DEGREE OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR YIELDING ELONGATED STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPHS...SPLITTING SUPERCELLS WILL BE PROBABLE. THIS WILL TEND TO FAVOR A PRIMARY THREAT OF LARGE HAIL /WHICH COULD BE SIGNIFICANT/ GIVEN STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS WEAK /PER AREA VWP DATA/...RELATIVELY LOW DEW POINT DEPRESSIONS COULD SUPPORT A WEAK TORNADO OR TWO...PROBABLY TOWARDS EARLY EVENING IF DISCRETE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE MAINTAINED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP INTO THE EVENING HOURS ACROSS MUCH OF NORTHEAST COLORADO. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT...HOWEVER AN ISOLATED NON-SUPERCELL TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1945 UTC THUNDERSTORMS WERE BEGINNING TO DEVELOP ACROSS NORTHEAST COLORADO ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 1500-2500 J/KG RANGE COUPLED WITH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR VALUES OF 25-35 KTS WILL YIELD THE POTENTIAL FOR MULTI-CELL CLUSTERS AND TRANSIENT SUPERCELL-LIKE STRUCTURES. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY OF THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. ADDITIONALLY...STRONG LOW-LEVEL INSTABILITY /0-3KM CAPE VALUES NEARING 200 J/KG/ COUPLED WITH THE PRESENCE OF REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL YIELD THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ISOLATED NON-SUPERCELLULAR TORNADO. AT THIS TIME...A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. HOWEVER...IF THUNDERSTORM INTENSITY IS MORE THAN CURRENTLY EXPECTED A WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS MAY CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY DEVELOP ACROSS EASTERN WY THIS EVENING...WITH SEVERE HAIL AS THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/A BRIEF TORNADO ALSO POSSIBLE. MAIN UNCERTAINTY FOR A WATCH ISSUANCE IS THE COVERAGE/EXTENT OF THE SEVERE RISK...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TOWERING CU CONTINUES TO OCCUR ACROSS NORTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL WY ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY OF THE BIG HORN/LARAMIE MOUNTAINS. WITH EARLY DAY STRATUS HAVING ERODED...THE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS CONTINUES TO STEADILY DESTABILIZE WITH WEAKENING CINH AND AN ESTIMATED 1500+ J/KG OF MLCAPE ACROSS THE EASTERN THIRD OF WY INTO FAR SOUTHWEST SD. 30 KT WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL WINDS ATOP EAST-SOUTHEASTERLY NEAR-SURFACE WINDS IS CONTRIBUTING TO 50+ KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS ESPECIALLY GIVEN THE INSTABILITY. THAT SAID...WITH THE MORE CONSEQUENTIAL FORCING FOR ASCENT LIKELY FOCUSED FARTHER NORTH INTO MT...THE PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY IS THE NUMBER/COVERAGE OF STORMS ACROSS WY...ALTHOUGH AT LEAST A COUPLE OF STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS MAY TRANSITION EASTWARD ACROSS THE EASTERN WY PLAINS THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING. OF MORE CERTAINTY MAY BE FOR STORMS TO INCREASE LATER THIS EVENING INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS AS WARM ADVECTION INCREASES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 464 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z...WITH TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUING MAINLY OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS /THROUGH 01Z/ ACROSS NORTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL CO...INCLUDING AREAS NEAR/NORTH OF DENVER AND AREAS NEAR I-70 NEAR/WEST OF LIMON. LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS OTHERWISE REMAIN POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPLEX STORM MODE IS ONGOING ACROSS NORTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL CO WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM ALONG/EAST OF I-25 NORTH OF DENVER SOUTHEASTWARD TO NEAR I-70 AND THE LIMON VICINITY. WITHIN A VERY MOIST/LOW LCL ENVIRONMENT...TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF MAINLY BRIEF TORNADOES WILL CONTINUE IN VICINITY OF WEST-SOUTHWESTWARD SHIFTING OUTFLOW AND NEAR STORM MERGERS...ALTHOUGH OUTFLOWS/COOLER INFLOW SHOULD FURTHER SPATIALLY LIMIT THE TORNADO POTENTIAL BEYOND THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. BOUTS OF LARGE HAIL WILL OTHERWISE REMAIN A CONCERN...AND DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL COULD INCREASE A DEGREE IF STORM MERGERS/UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS OCCURS...A TREND THAT MAY ALREADY BE UNDERWAY ACROSS NORTHEAST CO. ..GUYER.. 08/03/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND A FEW DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST INTO THE EARLY EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF ERN MT. SOME CONSOLIDATION IS POSSIBLE INTO A CLUSTER OR LINE SEGMENTS ACROSS E-CNTRL AND SERN MT AND THE WRN DAKOTAS THROUGH WATCH EXPIRATION TIME OF 03Z. THE POSSIBILITY FOR A NEW WW IS BEING CLOSELY MONITORED OVER THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH POSITIONED NEAR THE MT-CANADIAN BORDER APPEARS TO BE ACCELERATING EWD PER RECENT WATER VAPOR LOOP. DEEP-LAYER ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE IS CONTRIBUTING TO ISOLATED BUT PERSISTENT SUPERCELLS...WITH TWO OVER GARFIELD COUNTIES AS OF 2330Z. REPORTS OF LARGE HAIL FROM THESE STORMS IS CONSISTENT WITH WDSS-2 MESH ALGORITHM OUTPUT...AND THIS SHOULD REMAIN THE MAIN THREAT OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN SERN MT...BUT THIS AREA IS FARTHER REMOVED FROM STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT AND IS IN PROXIMITY TO WEAK MIDLEVEL HEIGHT RISES. MOIST ESELY INFLOW WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A SUFFICIENTLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS FOR VIGOROUS CONVECTION OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HRS. A SLOWLY STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET...ALONG WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SOME COLD POOL CONSOLIDATION...COULD RESULT IN A CONVECTIVE CLUSTER OR LINE PROPAGATING ESEWD TOWARDS E-CNTRL AND SERN MT LATER THIS EVENING...WHICH IS ALSO THE SCENARIO DEPICTED BY SOME HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL GUIDANCE /INCLUDING RECENT HRRR AND 12Z WRF-NSSL RUNS/. IF THIS OCCURS...AN ACCOMPANYING RISK FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY EXIST THROUGH WATCH EXPIRATION TIME OF 03Z...AND COULD REQUIRE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW. ..ROGERS.. 08/03/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 465 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z WITH THE PRIMARY SEVERE RISK NEAR THE I-25 CORRIDOR OF SOUTHEAST CO. OTHER SEVERE TSTMS REMAIN POSSIBLE...MAINLY ON A MARGINAL/ISOLATED BASIS...ACROSS NORTHEAST NM/NORTHERN TX PANHANDLE...AND PERHAPS INTO AREAS SUCH AS NORTHWEST OK/FAR SOUTHERN KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO NEAR/EAST OF I-25...STORM MERGERS/SOUTHWESTWARD MOVING OUTFLOW CONTINUES TO RESULT IN A TRANSIENT/SOUTHWESTWARD-SHIFTING SUPERCELL MODE WITH ASSOCIATED BRIEF TORNADO RISK...SUCH AS CURRENTLY ONGOING AS 01Z ACROSS ELBERT/EASTERN EL PASO COUNTIES. THIS SAME SCENARIO MAY CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO /02Z/ PRIOR TO PROGRESSIVELY MORE HOSTILE STORM MERGERS AND INCREASINGLY COOLER/MORE STABLE INFLOW...WHICH WILL TEND TO FURTHER LIMIT THE TORNADO POTENTIAL. NONETHELESS...HAIL/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH MID-EVENING. FARTHER SOUTH...CONVECTIVE INTENSITY HAS GENERALLY DIMINISHED CONSIDERABLY ACROSS NORTHEAST NM/OK PANHANDLE AND MUCH OF THE NORTHERN TX PANHANDLE. GRADUALLY INCREASING WARM ADVECTION IN VICINITY OF NORTHWEST OK/SOUTHERN KS FRONTAL ZONE SHOULD LEAD TO AN INCREASE IN TSTMS THE REMAINDER OF THE NIGHT. PERSISTENT/LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL WILL BE MORE PREVALENT GIVEN RELATIVELY WARM TEMPERATURES ALOFT/MODEST MID-LEVEL WINDS. THAT SAID...SOME LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE/SEVERE HAIL RISK CANNOT BE ENTIRELY DISCOUNTED AS STORM INCREASE FROM THE NORTHEAST TX/EASTERN OK PANHANDLES INTO FAR NORTHERN OK/SOUTHERN KS TONIGHT. HOWEVER...A WATCH DOES NOT SEEM LIKELY FOR THIS SCENARIO. ..GUYER.. 08/04/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 466 CONTINUES UNTIL 08Z...WITH DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL REMAINING POSSIBLE BUT ON AN ISOLATED/MARGINAL BASIS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DUAL BANDS OF TSTMS HAVE EVOLVED/PERSISTED EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD LATE THIS EVENING...WITH ONE IN FAR SOUTHWEST ND AS OF 0445Z...AND THE OTHER EXTENDING FROM FAR NORTHEAST WY INTO NORTHWEST SD. IN EACH CASE...CONVECTIVE INTENSITY HAS GENERALLY DIMINISHED OVER THE PAST 1-2 HOURS...WITH A GENERAL WARMING OF CLOUD TOPS PER IR SATELLITE IMAGERY...ESPECIALLY EXTREME SOUTHEAST MT INTO SOUTHWEST ND. AN EASTWARD MOVING MID-LEVEL IMPULSE NEARING THE MT/ND BORDER AND A NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET/WARM ADVECTION REGIME WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT AN EASTWARD TRANSITION OF THESE TSTM CLUSTERS...ALTHOUGH A REINTENSIFICATION OF STORMS DOES NOT SEEM PROBABLE. IN THE SHORT-TERM...THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL LIKELY REMAIN IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE RESIDUAL INSTABILITY AXIS ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST WY/EXTREME WESTERN SD. ..GUYER.. 08/04/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
